description: Add macOS (arm64 + x86_64) release binaries for the user-facing instinctagents CLI/TUI with auto-detecting install.sh, and migrate the maintainer-only internal Python tool (src/internal/) from pip + requirements.txt to uv with pyproject.toml + uv.lock, updating Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode slash command wrappers and CI accordingly.

userStories.title: Release workflow builds macOS arm64 binary
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the release workflow to build a macOS arm64 binary so Apple Silicon users have a download.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a macOS job (or matrix entry) to .github/workflows/release.yml running on macos-14 (Apple Silicon) that installs Rust stable with target aarch64-apple-darwin
Job runs `cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin` from src/external/
Resulting binary is stripped and copied to dist/instinctagents-macos-arm64
softprops/action-gh-release `files:` list includes dist/instinctagents-macos-arm64
Existing Linux x86_64 build and upload of dist/instinctagents-linux-x86_64 still succeeds unchanged
scripts/package-release-assets.sh still runs successfully alongside the new macOS build
Workflow file passes `actionlint` (or equivalent) with no errors
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Release workflow builds macOS x86_64 binary
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the release workflow to also build a macOS x86_64 binary so Intel Mac users have a download.
acceptanceCriteria: Release workflow builds for x86_64-apple-darwin (either via `rustup target add x86_64-apple-darwin` on the existing macOS runner or via a matrix entry — implementer's choice, documented in a YAML comment)
Binary is stripped and copied to dist/instinctagents-macos-x86_64
softprops/action-gh-release `files:` list includes dist/instinctagents-macos-x86_64
Final release contains all three platform binaries: instinctagents-linux-x86_64, instinctagents-macos-arm64, instinctagents-macos-x86_64
Workflow file passes `actionlint` with no errors
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: install.sh detects macOS and picks the right asset
userStories.description: As a macOS user, I want install.sh to auto-detect my OS and architecture and download the right binary.
acceptanceCriteria: install.sh `check_platform` accepts `Darwin` in addition to `Linux` without erroring
ASSET is no longer a top-level constant; it is computed from detected OS + arch
On Darwin + arm64/aarch64 the script targets `instinctagents-macos-arm64`
On Darwin + x86_64/amd64 the script targets `instinctagents-macos-x86_64`
On Linux + x86_64/amd64 the script targets `instinctagents-linux-x86_64` (unchanged behavior)
All other (OS, arch) combinations exit 1 with a single-line lowercase `error:` message naming both detected values
Destination path is `./instinctagents` and `chmod +x` is applied for every supported platform
`shellcheck install.sh` passes with no warnings
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Shell tests for install.sh platform detection
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want automated coverage of install.sh's OS/arch detection so a future edit cannot silently break macOS install.
acceptanceCriteria: Add scripts/test-install.sh (or extend existing scripts/test-package-release-assets.sh pattern) that stubs `uname` and `curl` and invokes install.sh
Test case: Linux + x86_64 → script requests URL ending in `/instinctagents-linux-x86_64` and exits 0
Test case: Darwin + arm64 → script requests URL ending in `/instinctagents-macos-arm64` and exits 0
Test case: Darwin + x86_64 → script requests URL ending in `/instinctagents-macos-x86_64` and exits 0
Test case: Linux + aarch64 → script exits non-zero and stderr contains `error:` and both `Linux` and `aarch64`
Test case: Darwin + i386 → script exits non-zero and stderr contains `error:` and both `Darwin` and `i386`
.github/workflows/ci.yml runs scripts/test-install.sh on every PR
Test script passes `shellcheck`
Typecheck passes

src/internal/README.md is updated to instruct maintainers to run `uv sync` (or rely on `uv run`) — no mention of `pip` or `requirements.txt` remains in that file
